name: LOW STOCK — product enters / leaves the LowStock collection
description: Fires on the raw match: the product, its stock and threshold isotopes, and the LowStock collection it just joined. Cancellations (product restocked) arrive too — the feed redraws the same shape.
query: MATCH (p) WHERE id(p) = $data.id MATCH (p)-[:HAS_INVENTORY_LEVEL]->(inv), (p)-[:HAS_REORDER_LEVEL]->(rl) MATCH (c:Collection {name: "LowStock"}) RETURN p, inv, rl, c

name: PO REJECTED — the PO, who rejected it, the line and product
description: Drawn the moment the rejection is fully written (the REJECTED_L1_BY edge is in the pattern). Watch the -R resubmission appear next to it a moment later — that node is written by the standing query itself.
query: MATCH (po) WHERE id(po) = $data.id MATCH (po)-[:REJECTED_L1_BY]->(e), (po)-[:HAS_PO_LINE]->(l)-[:FOR_PRODUCT]->(p) MATCH (c:Collection {name: "RejectedPoS"}) RETURN po, e, l, p, c

name: PO CLOSED — PO, delivery, supplier, and its lineage if any
description: Fires once the warehouse delivery is booked. The invoice the standing query writes appears on the canvas right after.
query: MATCH (po) WHERE id(po) = $data.id MATCH (po)-[:HAS_WAREHOUSE_DELIVERY]->(d), (po)-[:PO_SUPPLIER]->(s) OPTIONAL MATCH (po)-[:HAS_PREVIOUS_PO]->(prev) MATCH (c:Collection {name: "ClosedPoS"}) RETURN po, d, s, prev, c

name: ORDER SHIPPED — order, customer, carrier
description: One frame per shipment. Busy: ~120 a day. Toggle it on for a minute to see the cadence, then off.
query: MATCH (o) WHERE id(o) = $data.id MATCH (o)-[:HAS_ORDER_CUSTOMER]->(c), (o)-[:SHIPPED_VIA]->(s) RETURN o, c, s

name: CUSTOMER PROMOTED — a standing query's write fired another standing query
description: The order-shipped automation moved this customer into PreferredCustomers; this feed draws the customer, its spend isotope and the tier collection.
query: MATCH (cust) WHERE id(cust) = $data.id MATCH (cust)-[:HAS_SPEND]->(cs) MATCH (c:Collection {name: "PreferredCustomers"}) RETURN cust, cs, c

name: BACK ORDER — order enters / leaves BackOrders
description: The order, its customer, and the product lines it is waiting on. The cancellation (order released) redraws the same shape when it ships.
query: MATCH (o) WHERE id(o) = $data.id MATCH (o)-[:HAS_ORDER_CUSTOMER]->(cust), (o)-[:HAS_ORDER_LINE]->(l)-[:FOR_PRODUCT]->(p)-[:HAS_INVENTORY_LEVEL]->(inv) MATCH (c:Collection {name: "BackOrders"}) RETURN o, cust, l, p, inv, c
